newsitem.title: USA: Marquette Medical in pact with Physix.
newsitem.headline: Marquette Medical in pact with Physix.

text.p: Marquette Medical Suystems Inc said Thursday it formed a strategic alliance with Physix Inc that will combine Marquette Medical's patient monitoring systems with Physix's software technologies.
The company said it also made an unspecified equity investment in Physix, making it a minority stockholder.
The partners said the alliance is aimed at meeting the needs of health care delivery and management in the patient's home or in other non-acute care settings.
Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 20-3/8.
